personalInfo.name: K. Sai Prashanth
personalInfo.summary: Systems-thinking UI/UX Designer with over 6 years of experience in product design and brand identity, specializing in pixel-perfect SaaS solutions for US-based markets. Leverages a robust background in Electrical Engineering and an MBA in Project Management to effectively navigate technical constraints, manage complex project lifecycles, and drive high-efficiency Agile workflows. Proven expert in architecting end-to-end user journeys, from deep user research and competitive analysis to high-fidelity prototyping and the maintenance of scalable design systems.

experience.description:
• Led development of flagship product, increasing user engagement by 45%
• Managed team of 8 engineers and 3 designers
• Drove $2M in additional annual revenue through new feature launches

• Launched 3 major product features from concept to delivery
• Conducted user research with 200+ customers to inform product roadmap
• Improved conversion rates by 30% through A/B testing and optimization
